title: Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers

result.label: Sharp logarithmic exponents for off-diagonal Ramsey numbers
result.statement: For every fixed integer s ≥ 5, proves r(s,t)=t^ s-1 /( t)^ s-2+o(1) as t , determining the logarithmic exponent and matching the classical upper bound at that scale. Here r(s,t) is the least number of vertices forcing an s -clique or a t -vertex independent set.
